name: Explain & Plan
description: A soft-only demo workflow (Phase 1): restate the task, plan it, then execute. All steps are LLM steps.

data.prompt:
Restate the following task in one clear sentence so we are aligned on the goal:

{{inputs.task}}
Based on the restated goal ({{restate.output}}), outline a concise step-by-step plan (3-6 bullets) for how you will accomplish it.
Now carry out the plan ({{plan.output}}) and produce the final deliverable for the original task.
